hooks.name: projectile_world_border
hooks.neoforge: none (26.3's projectile world border collision, MC-310476)

rust_summary: a thrown projectile about to cross the world border, which a mod may move, slow or let through (`native_projectile_world_border`).
doc_summary: a thrown projectile at the world border: `native_projectile_world_border(dimension, entity, kind, pos, velocity, collide)` is heard each tick a thrown projectile inside the border would end its next step outside it, before 26.3 stops it there (MC-310476). A mod may change its position and velocity, or set `collide` false and it flies through this tick as before 26.3. No `self`. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:projectile_world_border@`.
